finalText:
Builds clean, exit 0.

Two real bugs from the bump, both were in link-stage config handling:
1. `src/core/options.js:6` — still read `options.retries`, but the new bundler passes `retryCount`. Fixed to read the right key.
2. `src/net/retryPolicy.js:7` — treated an unset flag as invalid instead of falsy. New config loader leaves unset flags as `undefined` instead of `false`. Fixed to treat `undefined` as disabled.

The remaining 8 warnings are just deprecation noise (`fs.exists`, `Buffer()`, punycode, etc.) — not build-breaking, cosmetic only.
